final_message:
I wrote the deviation report as a Word document. It finds the Hargrove draft lease cannot be financed as written: 57 provisions reviewed, 15 Critical, 27 High, 8 Medium and 7 Low or within market, plus 23 items the playbook says must go to the General Counsel. The biggest problems are that land cost is 12.94% of revenue in Year 1 (rising to 21% by Year 25, against an 8% lender cap), rent starts 24 months after signing, mineral and farming rights are reserved with no limits, every lender protection is missing, and the facility can be forfeited to the landlord on default. The report also corrects several errors in the source documents (wrong figures in the playbook, the lease draft and the email) and gives recommended positions, fallbacks, diligence items and a timetable to the October 15 signing target.
